name: KuroCat MCP
author: chanke17
description: Official MCP server for KuroCat (kurocat.cc), the 802 KB native open-source desktop cat pet & Bongo Cat alternative for macOS, Windows, Linux, and UOS. Design custom .kurocat 2.5D skins, author .kurokb mechanical keyboards, and browse or install free creations from the KuroCat Community Plaza.

localizations.name: KuroCat 桌宠皮肤工坊 MCP
localizations.description: KuroCat 原生开源桌面萌猫（kurocat.cc）官方 MCP 服务器：让 AI 助手直接为你捏专属 .kurocat 2.5D 猫咪皮肤、定制 .kurokb 机械键盘配色，并实时搜索和一键安装社区广场的免费皮肤与键盘（含小豆泥、怪猎呆猫、狸花猫等）。

tools.name: generate_cat_skin
tools.description: Design and validate a custom KuroCat v1 desktop cat skin (.kurocat JSON) with breed presets, hex palette, 2.5D shape sliders, and bezier coat regions, with optional 1-click install into KuroCat.

name.description: Display name of the cat skin (max 40 chars).

palette.description: Hex colors (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) for body, iris, belly, paws, points, etc.

shape.description: 2.5D body proportions (build, bodyWidth, headScale, cheekFullness, earSize, tailLength).

install.description: Install directly into the local KuroCat skins library.

tools.name: generate_keyboard_theme
tools.description: Design and validate a custom KuroCat 65% mechanical keyboard & mouse theme (.kurokb JSON) with optional local install.

tools.name: browse_community_plaza
tools.description: Live-search free community cat skins, 2.5D accessories, and mechanical keyboards from https://workshop.kurocat.cc/.

tools.name: install_community_asset
tools.description: Download a free community skin or keyboard by slug from https://workshop.kurocat.cc/ and install it into local KuroCat.

tools.name: list_installed_skins
tools.description: List all custom .kurocat cat skins and .kurokb keyboards installed in the local KuroCat app directory.

tools.name: validate_kurocat_json
tools.description: Strictly validate a .kurocat v1 or .kurokb JSON object against KuroCat's cross-platform parser specification.

resources.name: KuroCat .kurocat v1 Skin & .kurokb Keyboard Format Specification
resources.description: Coordinate system, palette keys, bezier regions, shape bounds, and local install paths.

resources.name: KuroCat Community Plaza Live Catalog
resources.description: Live JSON summary of community skins, accessories, and keyboards from https://workshop.kurocat.cc/.

prompts.name: design_my_cat
prompts.description: Turn a user's description of their real pet cat into a validated KuroCat .kurocat v1 skin.

prompts.name: design_matching_setup
prompts.description: Design a coordinated KuroCat cat coat (.kurocat) and 65% mechanical keyboard (.kurokb) pair.
